# Project Knowledge: Finance (ITF FROG)

Project rules for profile `finance`. Generated by the Project Setup Agent from `Synapse-itf-Dev` only. Items marked CONFIRM are inferred from names.

## Scope
- Repo `Synapse-itf-Dev` (Azure DevOps `gravity-development`) is the Git-integrated Synapse workspace `vwag-frog-itf-dev-syn-ws` for ITF (Adastra/PLBM/PAF Finance) and SharePoint data. (evidence: Synapse-itf-Dev/README.md)
- Ownership: Azure resources live in `itf-frog-infra`; deployment, environment overrides, and SQL deployment scripts live in `itf-frog-devops`. Change only Synapse artifacts here. (evidence: README.md "Relationship to Infrastructure and DevOps")
- Environments: Dev -> QS -> Prod; `template-parameters-definition.json` controls ARM parameterization. (evidence: README.md "Deployment")

## Team Rules
- Every PR/publish that changes a Synapse artifact or config must add a one-line entry under `[Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md`: `- [Artifact type] Name — what/why. (#PR, @author)`; include the Jira key. (evidence: CHANGELOG.md "How developers should update this file")
- Do not remove historical CHANGELOG entries. (evidence: CHANGELOG.md)

## Metadata / Orchestration (orchestrate)
- Classic master: `Pl_itf_masterpipeline_etl` (trigger `Master Trigger`, 09:00 IST) runs Copy -> Landing -> Curated -> Staging -> Core -> Reporting; failures logged via `dwh.sp_log_error`. (evidence: README.md)
- Medallion master: `PL_Master_Injection` (trigger `Delta_master_Trigger`, 07:00 IST) for current-date PlanenBM and 1CORE injection. (evidence: README.md)
- SharePoint master: `PL_DF_SP_Master_Pipeline` (07:30 IST) -> `PL_dataflow_sharepoint_data_Prod_01..08` -> `DF_sharepoint_Prod_01..08`; failures via `dbo.usp_SpDFMasterLogPipelineError`. (evidence: README.md)
- Curated and staging pipelines loop `ForEach` over parameter `feed_list` (parallel, batch 13). Add a feed by extending `feed_list` / `dwh.FinanceFeedMetadata` before creating pipelines. (evidence: README.md; sql.schemas.dwh) CONFIRM
- `_ALL`/`_ANY` family: `PL_RVS_To_Landing_ALL` / `_ANY`. (evidence: pipelines.all_any_families)
- SQL pool lifecycle pipelines (`PL_ScaleUp_SQLPool_dw400c`, `PL_ScaleDown_SQLPool_dw100c`, pause/resume) must not be changed for ETL work. All triggers use India Standard Time.

## Refine (curated, staging, silver)
- Curated: `NB_itf_dl_landing_to_curated`; staging/processing: `nb_itf_dl_Curated_to_Processing`. (evidence: README.md)
- Staging SQL: schemas `dwh_stg` and `dwh`; DDL folder `DWH_Scrpit/create_staging table`; load procs folder `DWH_Scrpit/staging-sp`. (evidence: sql.folders_top)
- Staging SCD2 pattern (`dwh.sp_Load_<table>`): source `dwh.<table>_Rawtable`; match on `KeyHash`, detect change with `ValueHash`; expire with `IsCurrent = 0, ValidTo = SYSUTCDATETIME()`; insert new current rows. Generic variants: `dwh.sp_DynamicCopyIntoTemp`, `dwh.sp_DynamicTempToStaging_SCD2`; audit `dwh.SCD2_Load_Audit`. (evidence: sp_Load_T_IMPORT_PAF_WA_Stammdaten_R4)
- Silver (medallion) is SCD Type 2 in notebooks: `NB_bronze_to_silver`, `NB_silver_table_schema`, `NB_silver_metadata_table_create`, `NB_silver_validation`. (evidence: notebooks.names; user)

## Model (core, gold)
- Core schema `dbo`: tables `T_DIM_<nn>_<Name>`, `T_IMPORT_*_neuesteDaten`; procs `P_DIM_<nn>_<Name>`, `P_IMPORT_*`; default SCD Type 1. DDL folder `DWH_Scrpit/create_core_table`; procs folder `DWH_Scrpit/create of stored procedure`. (evidence: sql.schemas.dbo, folders_top; user)
- Load drivers: `dbo.sp_Run_ETL_Driver` (and `dbo.SP_Master_Staging_to_Core`) call each `P_DIM_*`/`P_IMPORT_*` with `@ProcessDate` inside its own TRY/CATCH and insert failures into `dbo.ErrorLog (ProcedureName, ErrorMessage, ErrorNumber, ErrorSeverity, ErrorState, CreatedOn)`. Register every new core proc in the driver the same way. (evidence: sp_Run_ETL_Driver, SP_Master_Staging_to_Core)
- Proc pattern: `IF OBJECT_ID('<schema>.<proc>','P') IS NOT NULL DROP PROC ...; GO; CREATE PROC ... @ProcessDate [date]`, logging variables `@ProcedureNameForLog`, `@RaiseErrorDesc`, body in `BEGIN TRY`. References: `P_DIM_43_Kundenkostenstelle_SKST`, `P_IMPORT_FACT_PAF_WA_Uebersicht`. (evidence: P_DIM_43_Kundenkostenstelle_SKST.json)
- Table DDL pattern: `IF OBJECT_ID('<schema>.<table>','U') IS NULL CREATE TABLE ... WITH (DISTRIBUTION = HASH(<key>), HEAP)` and `PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED (...) NOT ENFORCED`. Reference: `T_DIM_43_Kundenkostenstelle_SKST`. (evidence: T_DIM_43_Kundenkostenstelle_SKST.json)
- `_history` variants of tables/procs live in folder `Historic Data Development/*` and are orchestrated by `SP_Master_Historic_Report`; change them together with the current version when the ticket requires it. CONFIRM
- Gold (medallion): one notebook per object `t_dim_*` / `t_fact_*`, DDL via `create_gold_table_statement`, run by `Gold_Layer_Execution`; `one_time_*` notebooks are initial loads. (evidence: notebooks.names)

## Serve (reporting, out_gold)
- Reporting schema `rpt`: `P_R_<Name>` procs (with `@ProcessDate`) build reporting tables, orchestrated by `rpt.SP_Master_Core_to_Reporting`; folder `DWH_Scrpit/create_reporting_view_table`. Reference: `P_R_WA_Dashboard`. Consumer: Power BI `PowerBI_FROG_ITS`. (evidence: README.md, P_R_WA_Dashboard.json)
- Serverless gold: database `it_finance`, schema `out_gold` external tables/views (`t_dim_*`, `t_fact_*`) created by `meta.p_CreateAllExternalTables_ItFinance` (script `p_UpdateExternalTables`); folders `Serverless/01_Schemas` .. `04_Views`. (evidence: sql.schemas.out_gold, sql.schemas.meta)
- Row-level security: `T_USERRLS`, `usp_UpdateUserRLSDepartment`; do not change exposure without explicit approval. (evidence: create_core_table folder, procedure_prefixes) CONFIRM
